entries.reason: Single dependent was aphrody-bun, which already enabled feature `svg` and already depends on aphrody-svg[glyph] and base64, so the merge only adds skrifa, read-fonts and woff2 (workspace deps) to a crate that already carried them transitively through aphrody-icons. The `svg` feature is now unconditional (aphrody-bun is std), so the `#![cfg_attr(not(feature = "svg"), no_std)]` split, `extern crate alloc` and all `alloc::` imports became std. The optional `thiserror` dependency was dropped: rg thiserror crates/ui/icons/src returned nothing, SvgError implements Display/Error by hand. The optional `serde` feature (derive on SymbolStyle, Style, Axes, SvgError) is now an unconditional derive because aphrody-bun already depends on serde with `derive`; no dependent used the feature. Name collision resolved explicitly: the pre-existing FFI wrapper crates/ui/bun/src/icons.rs was renamed to crates/ui/bun/src/icons_ffi.rs (content identical except `aphrody_icons::` -> `crate::icons::`), so `unsafe` stays forbidden inside `icons` (#![forbid(unsafe_code)] kept) and the crate-root re-exports `bun_rs::icon_svg_json`, `bun_rs::bun_rs_icon_names`, `bun_rs::bun_rs_icon_svg` keep their paths and C symbols. #![warn(clippy::all)] is set inside `icons` to keep the original (warn) level under the crate-wide deny(clippy::all). Public path mapping: aphrody_icons::X -> bun_rs::icons::X for X in Axes, Style, SvgError, SymbolStyle, icon_names, icon_path, icon_svg, WOFF2_*, CSS_*. aphrody-ffi does `pub use bun_rs::*;` so `icons` is now also visible there (no name clash: rg icon crates/interop/ffi/src has no other hit).
